proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 2023 article gives Malayalam kai, kayyi hand, arm; trunk of elephant; handle; kayyu the hand; kayyāḷ an assistant, helper.. The Byari survey form kay “hand” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
